title: Trapping Rain Water
contract: Return total trapped water between nonnegative unit-width bars.
brute: long water=0;for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++){int left=0,right=0;for(int j=0;j<=i;j++)left=Math.max(left,a[j]);for(int j=i;j<a.length;j++)right=Math.max(right,a[j]);water+=Math.min(left,right)-a[i];emit("Find both boundary maxima for a position","index",i,"boundaries",new int[]{left,right},"water",water);}return water;
optimal: int l=0,r=a.length-1,left=0,right=0;long water=0;while(l<=r){if(left<=right){left=Math.max(left,a[l]);water+=left-a[l++];}else{right=Math.max(right,a[r]);water+=right-a[r--];}emit("Resolve the side with the smaller known boundary","pointers",new int[]{l,r},"maxima",new int[]{left,right},"water",water);}return water;
reasoning: For each bar, water depth is min(maxLeft,maxRight) minus its height.
The side with the smaller known maximum can be finalized: the opposite known boundary is already tall enough.
Advance only the resolved side and update its maximum before adding water. Unlike container area, trapped water sums contributions at every position.
